title: Weekly review
audience: For anyone who wants twenty calm minutes on Sunday instead of a vague Monday.
description: A weekly review your AI runs with you. It asks five questions, then writes the week up in Pinto Notes, newest first.
tagline: Five questions every Sunday, written up for you.
note:
Weekly review

Twenty minutes on Sunday. Your AI asks the questions, and the answers land here, newest week first.

## Questions
1. What went well this week?
2. What didn't, and why?
3. What did I learn?
4. What am I grateful for?
5. What are my top three for next week?

## Reviews

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Weekly review". When I say it's time for my weekly review, ask me the questions under "Questions" one at a time. Then add the week at the start of "Reviews" with append_to_note (at_start): a "### Week of" heading with Monday's date, my answers as short bullets in my own words, and my top three as a checklist. When I tell you one is done, tick it with set_checklist_item.

asks: It's time for my weekly review.
What did I say I'd focus on last week?
What keeps coming up in my reviews?

args.text:
### Week of 28 September
- **Went well:** shipped the pricing page; two early nights.
- **Didn't:** no deep work on Thursday, too many meetings.
- **Learned:** a 30-minute agenda beats a 60-minute meeting.
- **Grateful for:** dinner with my sister.
- [ ] Block Thursday mornings for deep work
- [ ] Send the Q4 plan to Jonas
- [ ] Book the dentist
